title: Encrypted Messaging Policy Template - Secure Communication Guidelines
metaDescription: Ready-to-use encrypted messaging policy template. Define secure communication standards for teams, families, or organizations using Signal, WhatsApp & more.
description: A comprehensive policy template to establish secure messaging guidelines for your organization or group. Covers app selection criteria, encryption standards, and best practices for private communication using Signal, WhatsApp, and other encrypted messaging platforms.

sections.heading: Policy Statement and Scope
sections.content: This Encrypted Messaging Policy establishes secure communication standards for [ORGANIZATION_NAME]. This policy applies to all [STAKEHOLDERS] and covers the use of encrypted messaging applications for internal communications, client interactions, and sensitive information sharing. The purpose is to protect confidential information, ensure privacy compliance, and maintain secure communication channels while enabling effective collaboration.

sections.heading: Approved Messaging Applications
sections.content: The following messaging applications are approved for use based on their end-to-end encryption standards: [PRIMARY_APP] (primary recommendation for maximum security), [SECONDARY_APP] (acceptable for general use), and [BACKUP_APP] (backup option). All approved applications must support end-to-end encryption by default, offer disappearing messages, and have undergone independent security audits. Prohibited applications include any platforms that do not provide end-to-end encryption or store messages on company servers without encryption.

sections.heading: Security Requirements and Settings
sections.content: All users must enable the following security features: disappearing messages set to [MESSAGE_RETENTION_PERIOD], screen security to prevent screenshots, two-factor authentication on all accounts, and automatic app lock after [LOCK_TIMEOUT]. Registration lock must be enabled where available. Users should verify safety numbers/security codes when communicating with new contacts and report any security warnings immediately. Regular security updates must be installed within [UPDATE_TIMEFRAME] of release.

sections.heading: Information Classification and Usage Guidelines
sections.content: Confidential and sensitive information may only be shared through approved encrypted messaging apps with verified contacts. [SENSITIVE_DATA_TYPES] require additional verification of recipient identity before transmission. Public or general information may use standard communication channels. File sharing should be limited to [FILE_SIZE_LIMIT] and must not include [PROHIBITED_FILE_TYPES]. All business-related conversations should be backed up to approved secure storage solutions when required for compliance or record-keeping purposes.

placeholders.label: Types of Sensitive Data
placeholders.defaultValue: Financial information, personal data, proprietary information, and client communications

placeholders.label: Prohibited File Types
placeholders.defaultValue: executable files, unencrypted databases, or password-protected archives

sections.heading: Group Chat and Multi-Party Communication
sections.content: Group chats containing sensitive information must be limited to [MAX_GROUP_SIZE] verified participants. Group administrators are responsible for verifying all member identities and maintaining an updated participant list. New members require approval from [APPROVAL_AUTHORITY] before being added to sensitive groups. Group names should not reveal confidential project details or sensitive information. All group chats should have disappearing messages enabled and regular participant audits conducted every [AUDIT_FREQUENCY].

sections.heading: Device Security and Account Management
sections.content: Encrypted messaging apps must only be installed on [APPROVED_DEVICES] that meet our device security requirements. Personal devices require [PERSONAL_DEVICE_REQUIREMENTS] before approval for business use. Lost or compromised devices must be reported immediately to [INCIDENT_CONTACT] for account deactivation and security assessment. Users are prohibited from using messaging apps on public computers, shared devices, or unsecured networks without VPN protection. We recommend using a privacy-focused browser for web-based messaging interfaces when mobile apps are unavailable.

placeholders.label: Approved Device Types
placeholders.defaultValue: company-managed smartphones, tablets, and authorized personal devices

placeholders.label: Personal Device Security Requirements
placeholders.defaultValue: device encryption, screen lock, and mobile device management (MDM) enrollment

sections.heading: Compliance and Monitoring
sections.content: This policy supports compliance with [APPLICABLE_REGULATIONS] and organizational data protection requirements. While we respect privacy rights, users acknowledge that business communications may be subject to legal discovery requests and regulatory audits. Violation of this policy may result in [DISCIPLINARY_ACTIONS]. Policy compliance will be reviewed during [REVIEW_SCHEDULE] and updated as needed to address new security threats or regulatory changes. Training on secure messaging practices will be provided to all users initially and refreshed [TRAINING_FREQUENCY].

placeholders.label: Applicable Regulations
placeholders.defaultValue: GDPR, HIPAA, SOX, and other relevant data protection laws

placeholders.label: Policy Violation Consequences
placeholders.defaultValue: disciplinary action up to and including termination
